subject: Mediquant: targeted erasure SLA mapping & CAIQ retention clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@mediquant.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Question: customer-specific retention carveout & CAIQ items

Hi Irene —

Thanks for taking this. We're finalizing our procurement/security review with our compliance team and have a couple of Mediquant-specific asks around retention and CAIQ evidence. High level: can Redwood support a 45-day TTL for session/debug logs (hosted account) scoped to our tenant, and can you provide CAIQ control artifacts that confirm elimination and proof-of-delete for those logs?

Attachments: Mediquant-DataMap-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet listing systems & required retention)

Specific asks: 
- Can session/debug traces generated by our integrations be configured to auto-delete after 45 days (not archived)?
- For SOC2 / CAIQ items, can you provide a record-of-delete manifest (timestamp + object ids) and an example audit extract showing deletion operations?
- Are there any limitations if we request a tenant-scoped deviation from Redwood’s standard 90-day debug retention?

We'd like to get a short written response we can share with our security team by next Tuesday (11/10). Happy to join a 30-minute call if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer\Security & Privacy Lead\MediQuant Health
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@mediquant.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Question: customer-specific retention carveout & CAIQ items

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answer up front: we can support tenant-scoped retention adjustments in our Hosted offering but there are a few operational and evidentiary caveats we'll need to align on.

Plan: 
1) Internal check on the exact retention toggle behavior for session/debug traces (Karthik) and whether we can enforce non-archival policy at the tenant level.
2) Marissa will prepare a CAIQ-aligned evidence pack and a sample proof-of-delete manifest (redacted IDs) you can share with your security reviewers.
3) I'll book a 30-min workshop with you next week to walk through the artifacts and any contractual language for a 45-day SLA carveout.

I've attached a short deck that describes our erasure process and what manifest artifacts look like.

Attachments: Redwood-Erasure-Process-Slides.pptx (high-level process + sample outputs)

Would Tuesday 11/10 at 10:00am PT work for a call?

Best,
Irene\Irene Choi\Senior Security & Compliance Manager\Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Mediquant retention carveout & CAIQ — ask from Alex Mercer

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Alex's request from Mediquant (see original below). Quick summary of what they want and what I need from you: 

Summary of asks from Mediquant: 
- Tenant-scoped 45-day TTL for session/debug traces (hosted) with guarantee that items are not archived beyond that window.
- CAIQ evidence demonstrating deletion controls + a sample proof-of-delete manifest for SOC2 reviewers.
- Clarify any contractual limitations and proposed amendment language.

Marissa — can you draft a CAIQ answer pack scoped to the controls in question (evidence links, artifact examples, and a short explanation of how our manifest is generated)? Please redact any tenant IDs in sample manifests. Target: draft by EOD Monday so I can run it by Alex before the call.

Karthik — operational / product question: is there an existing toggle in Hosted that enforces non-archival deletion at 45 days for session/debug traces? If not, what workarounds (e.g., scheduled purge job, selective bucket retention policy) are viable? Also confirm whether we can generate a manifest of deletion operations (timestamps + object ids + deletion status) that we are comfortable sharing as a redacted sample.

Notes on compliance caveats to include in responses: 
- Legal holds/forensics requests may supersede deletion for defined windows. Need to confirm how we surface exceptions to customers.
- For proof-of-delete, we should provide an explanation of cryptographic or operational guarantees (manifest, S3 delete markers, or DB tombstones) but avoid exporting sensitive production keys.

Thanks — I want to make the customer-facing packet tidy and defensible.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mediquant retention carveout & CAIQ — ask from Alex Mercer

Irene / Karthik — quick answers & next steps. Attaching the draft CAIQ pack and a redacted proof-of-delete example.

Answers (short):
- Tenant-scoped 45-day TTL: Supported via a tenant-level lifecycle policy we can apply to their debug/session buckets; policy enforces deletion (no archive) for objects older than 45d. We need a signed amendment (language below).
- Proof-of-delete manifest: We can generate a manifest (timestamp, object key hash, delete operation id). I'll redact keys and include sample hashes. Good for SOC2 review.
- Limitations: We cannot enforce retention shorter than monitoring/forensics legal-hold windows; if a legal hold is active we mark as "suspended deletion" and surface via the manifest. We can include this behavior in the CAIQ narrative.

Proposed contract amendment language (short): 
"Redwood agrees to apply a tenant-scoped data lifecycle policy to MediQuant's debug/session object store enforcing permanent deletion of objects 45 days after creation, subject to lawful holds and forensic preservation requests. Redwood will provide redacted proof-of-delete manifests upon request for compliance review."

Next steps: 
- Irene: share draft CAIQ + manifest with Alex for quick review today.
- Karthik: confirm mechanistic details (which bucket label we apply + expected SLA for manifest export) so we can finalize wording.

Attachments: Mediquant-CAIQ-answers-draft.pdf, mediquant-proof-of-delete-sample.json (redacted)

Marissa\Senior Compliance Analyst\Redwood Inference
